Can a pillar in front of an exit get more people out?
Two hundred people rush for one narrow door. They jam into an arch, and in the first minute, only 47 get out.
Put a pillar right at the door, and it blocks the way. Just 18.
Move it back, dead centre, and it's still worse than no pillar at all.
But place it just off-centre, about a metre from the door.
It takes the push from the crowd behind, so people at the door can slip through. 59 get out.
Everyone is out in two minutes thirty-eight, instead of three minutes six.
A well-placed obstacle can actually speed up an exit.
